questions.question: Which package manager / build tool should be used, and what exact command installs dependencies?
questions.truth: yarn classic (packageManager yarn@1.22.22, workspaces). Install: `yarn install` at the repo root.
accept: yarn (classic) with `yarn install` or `yarn` from the repo root
reject: npm install / npm ci / pnpm install (package-lock.json is gitignored; yarn.lock is the lockfile)

questions.question: What exact command runs the full test suite?
questions.truth: Root `test` script = `yarn test:app` = `vitest` (CI runs `yarn test:app`). `yarn test:all` is the full gate (typecheck + eslint + prettier + vitest). vitest is watch mode on a TTY, so `yarn test:app --watch=false` is the one-shot form.

questions.question: What exact command runs only the tests in packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts?
questions.truth: Vitest runs from the repo root (root vitest.config.mts aliases all packages). One-shot: `yarn vitest run packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts` or `yarn test:app packages/element/tests/bounds.test.ts --watch=false`.
accept: npx vitest run <file> from the root
reject: cd packages/element && yarn test (no such script there)

questions.question: What exact command(s) check lint/formatting the way CI does?
questions.truth: CI (.github/workflows/lint.yml) runs `yarn test:other` (prettier --list-different on css/scss/json/md/html/yml), `yarn test:code` (eslint --max-warnings=0 --ext .js,.ts,.tsx .) and `yarn test:typecheck` (tsc).
accept: yarn test:code AND yarn test:other (typecheck `yarn test:typecheck` is an expected bonus, not required)
the raw equivalents: eslint --max-warnings=0 plus a prettier check
yarn test:all (includes all three plus tests)
reject: `yarn fix` / `fix:code` / `fix:other` as the only answer (they write files)

questions.question: Name files or directories in this repo that are generated or vendored and must not be edited by hand (or say none).
questions.truth: Generated/managed: yarn.lock; non-English translations packages/excalidraw/locales/*.json other than en.json (synced from en.json by Crowdin) and locales/percentages.json (generated by scripts/build-locales-coverage.js); gitignored build outputs (build/, dist/, dev-dist/, packages/excalidraw/types).
accept: yarn.lock and/or non-en locale files under packages/excalidraw/locales (only en.json is hand-edited) and/or build output dirs (dist/, build/, dev-dist)
